question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping's entrenched position within the Chinese Communist Party drives the strong trader consensus against his removal before 2027. Having secured an unprecedented third term at the 20th Party Congress in 2022 by abolishing prior term limits, he maintains control through elite reshuffling and military purges ahead of the 21st Congress expected in late 2027. Recent analyses show no verified signs of internal challenges or health events disrupting his leadership through mid-2026. While the implied probability reflects skin-in-the-game assessments of continuity, low-probability shifts could still arise from sudden health declines, elite factional moves, or major policy crises prompting unprecedented leadership changes before the end of 2026.
